what_it_does: Addresses the challenge of efficiently implementing breadth-first search (a fundamental graph traversal algorithm) on graphics processing units (GPUs) from different vendors including NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel. Proposes three load-balancing techniques to distribute computation evenly across GPU cores, improve memory access patterns, and avoid performance cliffs from uneven work distribution. Demonstrates a single code base using open standards that runs efficiently on all three GPU types.
